description: Given a free-text project description, say which of Ergin's services fits, its published price range, the tier a build like it usually lands in and the closest use cases. This is a published range, never a quote: the real price comes in writing after a free 30-minute call. Matching is keyword-based, so a description that names the problem, the systems and the volume matches best.

description.description: What should be built, in plain words: the problem, the systems involved, rough volumes. Leave out names, emails and other personal or confidential details.

name: estimate_project
title: Estimate a project
